label: soco53e measured st gas
definition: soco-53e: measured ST_GAS operating heat rates (ScenarioConfig.measured_st_heat_rates, gated, default-off), armed against the SOCO-53d keeper only. A fleet-load-time cost input, not a commitment mechanism: an ST_GAS row at a plant the committed CAMPD artifact covers takes its plant's own metered operating heat rate instead of the eGRID rate the loader assigns. It reaches what no eGRID construction can — at a mixed coal/gas steam station both boilers are prime mover ST, so the plant rate AND the prime-mover-family rate blend them; E C Gaston's ST family rate 11.5505 blends an 832 MW coal boiler with four ~255 MW gas boilers whose own meter reads 11.0744. Zero free parameters (rules 1 / 13 / 14 / 19 / 21 / 25). Capacity-weighted 10.9613 -> 10.8522 MMBtu/MWh (-1.0 %); per-plant Gaston -0.4761, Jack Watson -0.0532, Greene County -0.0489, Yates -0.0172 and Barry +1.3745 the other way. NOTE ON THE SCOPING NUMBER: the routing that commissioned this lane (FINDING-soco-53d 8.1) quoted +0.539 MMBtu/MWh / +5.2 %, having converted SOCO's BOILERS at the CT_PEAKER parasitic factor 0.99 where the ST_GAS class factor is 0.95 — the model never used 0.99; the scoping measurement did. Corrected before the solve. RESULT: determination NOT-YET (rubric v3.8, PRICE UNSCORED) on both sides, C1 all 13/14 / free 9/10 on both sides, C2/C4/C6/C8 PASS, 0 ledgered and 0 protective caveats, DOF unchanged at 3 entries / 1 residual. Every scored C1 row improves and none changes status: 2023 CT_PEAKER +9.90 -> +9.82 TWh (still the single FAIL, so SOCO's headline defect is NOT fixed), 2023 ST_GAS -6.97 -> -6.88, 2024 CT_PEAKER +6.55 -> +6.38, 2024 ST_GAS -5.40 -> -5.21. Reported against the lane: D-1's ST_GAS shape evidence is MIXED (cv_ratio worsens in 2023, improves in 2024/2025, all passing), and the arm leaves Gaston's COAL row on the same blended rate, now ~0.5 MMBtu/MWh too cheap, which measured_coal_heat_rates would close and which is routed, not absorbed. CANDIDATE awaiting the owner's promotion decision; SOCO's keeper remains 2026-09-19-soco53d-campaign-commitment. Evidence: docs/handoffs/FINDING-soco-53e-2026-09-19.md.
